meaning:
Zephath = "watch-tower"
a Canaanite city in Simeon renamed Hormah by the Israelites
Also named: chor.mah (חׇרְמָה "Hormah" H2767)

elsewhere.note: Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. The name of the city was called Hormah.
